versionHistory.notes:
1.3.1

Changed
- Hauts' Added Traits lets pawns gain a psylink if they have a latent psychic trait. But keeps them unawakened til first meditation.

Housekeeping
- Adding a way to reopen a waiting card pick straight from the Psycasters roster, instead of only through the alert.
- Two card windows on one awakening, and "flow of ancient knowledge" on a pawn who never awakened

1.3.0

Fixed
- Tier I re-deal handed back the identical hand — card pool seed had no term for it

Added
- Roster action bar can reopen a pick that was set aside

1.2.7

- Awakening re-deal button waits for the whole hand (reveal-all mode)

1.2.5

- Separate breakthrough chance sliders for before and after Illuminated

1.2.4

- Re-deal on a first awakening, and the window-add-during-PostClose hazard it exposed
- Unlocking a psycast now fires the level-up burst; it never had one
- Safe meditation can be set to a full 24h, which switches comas off entirely

1.2.3

- Rebuilt settings pages collapsed to just their first heading (Listing_Standard column break)
- Both tooltips drew on a psycast icon: the suppression patch targeted a method Mono inlines
- Removed individual pawn meditation gizmos as they can be changed on the main bar menu.
- Added per skill fog of war.

1.2.1

Fixed
- Pilgrimage quests never end: quest.End(sendStandardLetter:) binds to the QuestGen extension, NREs, latches the quest Ongoing forever
- Anima pilgrimage: one timed-out incomplete site leaves the quest Ongoing forever (same lockout as #155, different route)

Added
- Pilgrimage refire: pity progress now refunded on failure, and generation bail-outs attach an end part

Housekeeping
- Psycasters main tab replaces the dormant psycast tab (roster, stats, arrival estimates)
